name: Une Pêche Miraculeuse
source:
"We are in Vietnam, on the shores of Halong Bay in the 19th century. A fisherman and his grandson are about to go sailing. This fishing trip could, if they make the right choices, change their lives forever..."

[from [url=https://awonderfulbay.itch.io/visualnovel]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“我们在越南，在19世纪的下龙湾海岸。一位渔夫和他的孙子即将出海。如果他们做出正确的选择，这次钓鱼之旅可能会永远改变他们的生活……”

[来自[url=https://awonderfulbay.itch.io/visualnovel]itch.io[/url]]
